name: Housi
about: One system for the property manager, the service companies and the residents: from the report of a fault to the repair and its documents.

personas.name: Marlena Pietrasik
personas.role: Product owner of the resident app
personas.style: Practical. Gives the number of reports and residents, then the exact request.

personas.name: Kordian Siwiec
personas.style: Short lines, Polish mixed with English words (release, crash, fix).

personas.name: Józefa Wiącek
personas.style: Tells what the residents said on the phone. Long and kind messages, does not know issue keys.

personas.name: Wacław Grzelak
personas.role: Coordinator of the service companies, a former plumber
personas.style: Practical words of a craftsman (pion, zawór, przeciek). Short and direct.

personas.name: Ludmiła Szpak
personas.style: Exact dates, hours and numbers of the repair reports.

personas.name: Nikodem Ostrowiak
personas.style: Terse. Uses issue keys and names of statuses.

personas.name: Izabela Rudzka
personas.role: Product manager of the manager panel
personas.style: Names buildings by their address (ul. Lipowa 12) and asks for reports.

personas.name: Bolesław Kurant
personas.role: Advisor, a property manager with 30 years of practice
personas.style: Formal and old-fashioned. Does not trust apps, but is very polite.

personas.name: Matteo Rinaldi
personas.style: English with some Italian words (allora, perfetto, grazie).
